map.输入齿数、模数、压力角及齿根形式，计算渐开线花键的分度圆、大径、小径、基圆等尺寸: Enter the number of teeth, module, pressure angle and root form to compute the pitch circle, major diameter, minor diameter and base circle of an involute spline
map.💡 外花键：分度圆 D=mz；大径 DEE=m(z+1)；小径 DIE=m(z-: 💡 External spline: pitch circle D=mz; major diameter DEE=m(z+1); minor diameter DIE=m(z-1.5); base circle Db=D·cosα; tooth thickness s=πm/2
map.本计算依据 GB/T 3478 渐开线花键标准，30°平齿根最常用: This calculation follows the GB/T 3478 involute spline standard; the 30° flat root is the most common
map.30°压力角花键模数系列：0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3,5,10 等: Module series for 30° pressure angle splines: 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 5, 10, etc.
map.45°压力角花键齿较矮，用于薄壁连接或静连接: 45° pressure angle splines have shorter teeth and are used for thin-wall or static connections
map.内花键尺寸需对应配合（内花键大径=外花键大径+间隙）: The internal spline dimensions must mate accordingly (internal major diameter = external major diameter + clearance)
map.矩形/渐开线花键的分度圆、基圆、齿厚计算。: Pitch circle, base circle and tooth thickness calculation for rectangular/involute splines.
map.内外花键大/小径与齿侧配合校核。: Major/minor diameter and flank fit check of internal and external splines.
map.单齿弧长与挤压面积估算。: Single-tooth arc length and compression area estimation.
map.分度圆 D、压力角 α=30°：基圆 Db=D·cosα=D×0.866；齿厚: Pitch circle D, pressure angle α=30°: base circle Db=D·cosα=D×0.866; tooth thickness s=π·D/(2·z) (approximate); circular pitch p=π·D/z. For D=30, z=10: Db=25.98, p=9.425 mm.
map.传递扭矩 T、齿数 z、工作高度 h、平均半径 r：压强 p=2T/(z·h·r: For transmitted torque T, number of teeth z, working height h and mean radius r: pressure p=2T/(z·h·r·l), which must be below the allowable spline pressure.
map.渐开线齿根厚、强度高、自动定心好，常用于重载；矩形易加工、用于中小载。: The involute spline has a thick tooth root, high strength and good self-centering and is often used for heavy loads; the rectangular spline is easy to machine and is used for light-to-medium loads.
map.渐开线花键齿形由基圆发生，基圆决定齿形与定心方式（齿侧或外径定心）。: The involute spline tooth profile is generated from the base circle, which determines the tooth form and the centering method (flank or major-diameter centering).
map.花键规格计算器，依据 GB/T 3478 渐开线花键标准，根据齿数、模数、压力角: A spline specification calculator: per the GB/T 3478 involute spline standard, it computes the pitch circle, major diameter, minor diameter, base circle and tooth thickness of external/internal splines from the number of teeth, module, pressure angle and root form.
map.支持平齿根、圆齿根、45°三种形式: Supports three forms: flat root, fillet root and 45°
map.内外花键尺寸同步输出: Outputs internal and external spline dimensions together
map.齿厚与周节计算: Tooth thickness and circular pitch calculation
